subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress reconnect drain re-entry while delivery is in-flight

question: May the published `drainPendingDeliveries` return contract change from `Promise<void>` to a result object, or must Telegram receive this metadata through a backward-compatible additive seam?
rationale: The behavior fix needs queue outcome metadata, but choosing the permanent Plugin SDK contract is an external API decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Preserve the existing contract
options.body: Keep `Promise<void>` and introduce the narrowest additive, owner-approved callback or result-bearing seam needed by bundled Telegram code.

options.title: Approve the return-type change
options.body: Accept `Promise<ReconnectDrainResult>` as the new public contract with explicit compatibility rationale, SDK documentation, and external-consumer coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing contract
recommendation.body: Keep `Promise<void>` and introduce the narrowest additive, owner-approved callback or result-bearing seam needed by bundled Telegram code.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged delivery-queue dedupe work is the closest available ownership history for this API and recovery behavior.
